Revert: wall2024/pkgGPS/revert_AB.sql.
  - THE PUBLIC KEY CANNOT WRITE AN AUDIT ROW (ASK 466; database and three n8n log nodes):
    - What it does: anon and authenticated cannot INSERT into `audit_log`; cannot call `log_audit_event`, `complete_session_close`, `complete_security_check` or the class C writers (`log_build`, `log_change`, `save_session`, `abandon_fold_session`, `blackboard_ack`, `blackboard_close`, `blackboard_archive_any_author`, `conclusion_flag`, `init_load_session`, `dr_rest`, `dr_retract`); and cannot INSERT into the eleven seat-written tables (the_wall, the manuals, journal_entries, day_room_posts and the rest of the ASK 466 list). Eight row triggers (`debate_results_write_guard`, `truth_date_normalize`, `debate_judgments_write_guard`, `debate_prompts_guard`, `kb_row_audit`, `log_app_state_build`, `sight_embedding_fence`, `log_override_arming`) run SECURITY DEFINER with search_path public, pg_temp, so a table anon still writes keeps its audit rows; `log_override_arming` names the request role, not current_user.
    - The run path is unchanged: its RPCs (`record_debate_row`, `record_debate_judgment`, `record_enforcer_log`, `ppj_put`, `record_debate_row_tokens` and the rest) are SECURITY DEFINER and anon keeps EXECUTE on them; the anon `debate_results` insert still works.
    - The three n8n log nodes (Daily Drive Sync "Log Sync", Orphan Tables Snapshot and SQL Snapshot) call `rpc/log_audit_event` with the native "Supabase account" credential (service_role) and no own apikey or Authorization header.
    - Shown: a public-key call to `rpc/log_audit_event` returns 401 with 42501; a rolled-back test on live showed the refusals and the run-path survivals above.
    - Limits: the save path is shown only by the next run; its mark is a run whose judgment, row, enforcer and panel saves land with no permission error (42501); these saves write no audit row of their own (none on control run 39266). The three log nodes are shown only by their next scheduled runs, one audit row each. `log_override_arming` swallows every error, so a broken body would stop override logging silently. The revert of the table and trigger step needs two gate armings on the operator's word; the revert of the RPC step grants anon on the three RPCs and authenticated on `log_audit_event`.
